residual_definition: r = catch + predation + biomass_accumulation + net_migration - detritus_import + effective_M0 + external_mortality_sink - P. Positive r means outflows exceed P; absolute relative residual = abs(r)/max(abs(P),1e-12). All six expectations used r_new = r_baseline - 0.9*D_baseline.
coefficient_relative_change_definition: (sensitivity - baseline)/abs(baseline) for nonzero baseline. Zero-to-zero is reported as zero; zero-to-nonzero has null relative change and is listed explicitly. Maxima use absolute relative changes.

methods.footprint_definition: sum_i(total catch_i * scope SPPR_i), with total catch = landings + discards. This engine footprint is distinct from PP budget external-catch accounting.
